item.title: Aggies Struggle to Find Rhythm in Road Loss at Kennesaw State
item.description: KENNESAW, Georgia -- NM State (10-11, 3-8 CUSA) endured a tough night on the road, as Kennesaw State (14-8, 6-5 CUSA) pulled away for a 76-53 win this evening inside VyStar Arena.
